olivia: Heads-up: console ingestion started indexing X-Rd-RouteMeta today; dashboards show a 12% drop for legacy X-Route-Attr. Any SDK impacts?

jon: TS fetch wrapper strict about header keys, our tests flagged missing route tags. Go clients saw missing metrics too.

anya: Py OK (we normalize). Proposal: SDKs emit X-Route-Attr when X-Rd-RouteMeta present as a short-lived shim.

sam: Agree. Add env var RD_SDK_ROUTE_SHIM=true (default true) to allow opt-out, log at debug when shim used.

ci-bot: CI: devex/telemetry-shim (#101) triggered 1: windows header-casing test failed.

jon: I'll add casing-normalization tests for TS/Go. anya will prep py/ts patches.

olivia: Target patch releases tonight, keep to patch/minor. Mara (not in thread) will run backfill and we plan a 60-day window before removal.

anya: PRs opened, small changes, unit tests included.

sam: I'll update changelog and docs, and draft a short outbound note for Dedicated customers.

olivia: Thanks — please post PR links and release tags here when ready.
